summary: nejmSyncAllFeeds aggregates per-feed errors and returns a non-nil error only when every feed fails; partial success still returns (total, nil). nejmBaseURL became a var so tests can repoint it at an httptest server.
reason: The article list source is RSS-only (etoc + axatoc), so a total feed outage (network partition, DNS, Cloudflare block) must reach --json consumers, not just stderr. The generated loop swallowed every error with continue and always returned (total, nil), making sync.go's rss_fetch_error sync_warning branch unreachable dead code: a count:0 run was indistinguishable from completely broken feeds. A regen must keep the all-failed return path so the structured rss_fetch_error signal stays reachable.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli/ -run TestSyncNEJMFeeds: both-succeed returns (2,nil); single flaky feed returns (1,nil) with the failed feed named on the stderr writer; both-down returns (0, err) with an aggregated error naming etoc and axatoc.
